text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why this exact Google Information Security Engineering role fits the applicant's interests and trajectory.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in Google, security, or software engineering but gives little sense of why this exact role is the intended fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some genuine interest in the position, yet the reasons remain broad and could apply to many security or infrastructure roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the role to one or two relevant personal interests, such as security impact, infrastructure, or automation, in a believable but not especially distinctive way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains clearly why several specific aspects of this role match the applicant's experience and career direction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a compelling, personal rationale that makes this role on this team feel like a natural next step rather than a generic application."}]},{"name":"Charter understanding","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of the team's work automating security processes such as vulnerability handling, risk analysis, and secure lifecycle support.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reflects only a generic interest in security or back-end work and shows little grasp of the team's automation-centered mission."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security tooling or automation in passing but does not show clear understanding of the problems this team is meant to solve."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a reasonable grasp of one major part of the charter, such as reducing manual security toil or automating vulnerability triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Accurately connects multiple charter elements, such as vulnerability handling, agentic tooling, and support for secure development practices."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced understanding of the role as building systems that scale security judgment across the organization through automation, developer assistance, and structured response workflows."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as helping developer teams do the secure thing by default rather than adding friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not frame security work as enabling other engineers and leaves little sense of an internal-customer mindset."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping other teams but does not clearly describe security as a developer-facing service."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the goal is to reduce friction or help engineers work more safely, but the point is only lightly developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes secure defaults, reduced toil, or tools that other engineers can adopt without extra burden."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a strong service mindset by repeatedly treating security as developer enablement through thoughtful tooling, good defaults, and respect for how busy teams actually work."}]},{"name":"Operational mindset","description":"How clearly the letter conveys that the applicant values reliability, maintainability, bounded behavior, and long-term ownership after launch.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little indication of thinking beyond shipping features to reliability, maintenance, or life after launch."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions production or maintenance work but does not strongly convey habits of long-term ownership or careful operation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a basic maintainer mindset by noting testing, maintenance, inheritance, or the need for systems to keep working over time."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values dependability, boundaries, auditability, or thoughtful long-term ownership as part of how systems should be built."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes operational discipline a defining trait, presenting reliability, maintainability, and bounded behavior as central engineering values."}]},{"name":"Software delivery depth","description":"How strong the letter's evidence is of testing, maintaining, launching, and owning production software systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Sits at the lower end of the observed range on years or service count and gives only a limited sense of end-to-end product ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Meets the baseline with some testing, maintenance, and launch work, but the breadth of production experience remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-range production experience across several years or services, with credible exposure to the full software lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents strong production depth through multiple launches and convincing ownership of systems in operation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the top end of observed delivery depth, combining substantial years, several launched services, and a seasoned maintainer-builder perspective."}]},{"name":"Go alignment","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates relevant production experience building back-end systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions professional Go use but gives little evidence that it is a major or deeply practiced part of the applicant's work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some relevant Go experience, though the scale, ownership, or centrality of Go remains only moderately clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a regular working language for production software."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a major professional language used to build important back-end services or infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong alignment by making Go the primary production language and tying it to substantial system design or ownership work."}]},{"name":"Python alignment","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates relevant experience using Python for services, automation, or AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of Python use relevant to the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests basic familiarity with Python but gives little sense of substantial professional use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, scripts, service prototypes, or internal automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents strong Python experience across multiple relevant contexts such as services, automation, analysis, or internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong fit by describing production-grade Python work that is central to automation, services, or agent-based systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates applied skill with data structures and algorithms in real engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not substantiate algorithmic skill or mentions it only as a generic capability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims competence with data structures or algorithms but gives little concrete evidence of applying it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one believable example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, relevant example showing strong algorithmic judgment in production engineering."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows standout applied fluency through concrete redesigns where algorithmic choices materially improved performance, tractability, or system behavior."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How well the letter demonstrates practical experience assessing systems for security risk.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no direct evidence of having assessed systems for security risk."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals general security interest but little real assessment practice beyond broad enthusiasm or adjacent activities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States practical experience with security reviews, threat modeling, code review, or release-cycle assessment at a basic level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment methods or contexts, such as attack-surface review, remediation validation, or reviewing systems not originally written by the applicant."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents broad, credible hands-on assessment experience with a clear methodology and a strong attacker-minded perspective."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How strongly the letter shows direct experience automating the intake, triage, routing, or analysis of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention building automation for vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or analysis."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in reducing security toil but provides no direct evidence of having automated vulnerability handling."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions building automation around vulnerability intake or triage in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage functions such as classification, deduplication, routing, or shrinking a manual queue."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows direct ownership of impactful vulnerability automation that clearly replaced manual work and scaled expert attention."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling ownership","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates design or ownership of agent-based systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic or agent-based systems relevant to the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to automation or AI agents vaguely, without showing clear design responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building agentic systems but with limited architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a clear architecture in which agents act within constraints enforced by surrounding services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong direct alignment by explaining deliberate design of bounded, auditable agent workflows, especially with Python agents and Go infrastructure."}]},{"name":"AI production relevance","description":"How well the letter demonstrates practical experience building and operating AI-enabled software in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of working with AI systems relevant to production software."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI experience vaguely, without showing production use or lessons learned."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible hands-on work with model-backed or LLM-based features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work together with evaluation, guardrails, or reliability considerations."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents especially strong AI relevance by showing mature production experience and a clear understanding of how to make AI systems dependable."}]},{"name":"Independent security development","description":"How much the letter shows proactive security skill-building beyond ordinary job duties, such as competitions or certifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no evidence of security skill-building beyond ordinary job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides only a light signal, such as casual interest or occasional participation, with little proof of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a moderate signal through regular CTF participation or a baseline security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong extra-role development through an advanced certification or clearly serious competition performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional extra-role security development through both high-signal credentials and sustained high-level competitive or practical security practice."}]},{"name":"External engineering initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed engineering through open-source maintenance or substantial personal projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no example of meaningful engineering initiative outside normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small or casual side project with limited evidence of sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some initiative through a maintained personal project or occasional open-source contribution."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial independent ownership through an open-source project with users or a technically serious personal build."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows standout initiative through sustained external maintenance or an especially ambitious systems project that evidences deep curiosity and follow-through."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete and substantiated the letter's claims are about experience, skills, and impact.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad assertions of skill or fit without concrete supporting examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few facts about background, but most important claims remain generic or weakly supported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several relevant examples or facts, though ownership, outcomes, or technical detail remain only partly developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Supports key claims with concrete examples, clear responsibilities, or believable outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds the case in precise, role-relevant evidence that makes ownership and impact easy to see."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level, including spelling, grammar, terminology, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or terminology errors that substantially weaken professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has repeated noticeable errors that do not block comprehension but regularly distract the reader."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally readable but includes occasional errors or awkward phrasing that slightly interrupt the flow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and professional with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally polished, precise, and essentially error-free."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How clearly the letter organizes its material into a persuasive, easy-to-follow case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels scattered, list-like, or weakly connected, making the overall case hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but moves choppily or leaves important links between experience and role only implicit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a sensible progression and is easy enough to follow, though the overall throughline is not especially strong."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a clear, well-ordered argument linking background, motivation, and role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a particularly cohesive and memorable narrative in which the applicant's experience and interest in the role reinforce each other throughout."}]}]}
